patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with large, elegant typography on the left and a warm, inviting image on the right, establishing a personal and sophisticated tone.
Alternating soft, muted background colors (cream, light grey, dark brown, soft green, peach) define distinct content sections, creating visual rhythm without harsh transitions.
Prominent use of a large, elegant serif font for main headings, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and small, subtle mono-spaced accents for labels.

Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport, creating a gentle, guided scrolling experience. The main navigation bar sticks to the top after scrolling past the hero, maintaining its original size and appearance.
Integration of whimsical, hand-drawn line illustrations (e.g., bunnies, baby rattles) throughout the page, adding a playful and personal touch to an otherwise elegant design.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered animation system, likely using a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger or similar CSS keyframes, to reveal content sections. As a section's top edge enters the viewport, it fades into view while simultaneously translating slightly upwards, giving a soft, staggered reveal effect. The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that remains fixed at the top of the viewport after the initial hero section scrolls out of view, maintaining its full size and styling.

The visual design relies on a carefully selected palette of soft, warm, and muted colors for backgrounds and accents, creating a cohesive and inviting atmosphere. Large, elegant serif fonts are used for display text, often set against ample white space, to convey a sense of luxury and expertise. Body text uses a highly legible sans-serif font for clarity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, oversized serif headings (~3-4x body) with clean sans-serif body text and small, subtle mono-spaced labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and cards, contributing to a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous padding around sections and content blocks, especially in the hero, creating an open and uncrowded layout.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its sophisticated blend of elegant, large serif typography and a soft, warm, muted color palette, which together create a luxurious yet nurturing and approachable feel. The integration of whimsical, hand-drawn illustrations adds a unique, personal, and memorable touch that elevates it beyond a generic service site.
